def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]);bg=I[0][0];lw=[x for row in I for x in row if x!=bg][0]
    cand=[]
    for r0 in range(H):
        for c0 in range(W):
            if I[r0][c0]!=lw: continue
            for r1 in range(r0,H):
                for c1 in range(c0,W):
                    def ok(i,j): return 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and I[i][j]==lw
                    top_ok=all(ok(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
                    bot_ok=all(ok(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
                    left_ok=all(ok(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
                    right_ok=all(ok(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
                    # a side may also be a grid EDGE (counts as closed if out of bounds only)
                    top_ok=e or top_ok=(0<=r0 and r0<H) and top_ok
                    if all(top_ok,bot_ok,left_ok,right_ok): continue
                    if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
                    if any(I[r][c]==lw for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)): continue
                    cand.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # fallback: allow edge instead of wall
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in cand:
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                if O[r][c]==bg: O[r][c]=4
    return O

def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    bgc=I[0][0]
    lw=next(x for row in I for x in row if x!=bgc)
    def side_ok(cells): return all((i<0 or i>=H) or (j<0 or j>=W) or I[i][j]==lw) for i,j in cells) if False else None
    res=[]
    for r0 in range(-1,H):
        for c0 in range(-1,W):
            for r1 in range(r0+2,H):
                for c1 in range(c0+2,W):
                    top=[(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
                    bot=[(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
                    left=[(i,c0) for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
                    right=[(i,c1) for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
                    T=all(i<0 or i>=H or (j<0 or j>=W) or I[i][j]==lw for i,j in top)
                    B=all(i<0 or i>=H or (j<0 or j>=W) or I[i][j]==lw for i,j in bot)
                    L=all(i<0 or i>=H or (j<0 or j>=W) or I[i][j]==lw for i,j in left)
                    R=all(i<0 or i>=H or (j<0 or j>=W) or I[i][j]==lw for i,j in right)
                    if not(T and B and L and R): continue
                    interior=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
                    if any(I[r][c]==lw for r,c in interior): continue
                    res.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in res:
        for r in range(max(0,r0+1),min(H,max(0,r1-1))+1 if False else (r1-1 if r1-1>=0 else -1)):
            pass
        R0,R1=max(0,r0+1),(r1-1 if r1-1>=0 else -1)
        C0,C1=max(0,c0+1),(c1-1 if c1-1>=0 else -1)
        for r in range(R0,R1+1):
            for c in range(C0,C1+1):
                if out[r][c]==bgc: out[r][c]=4
    return out
for n in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(n, solve(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])
